method: Human selection of semantic dark components on numbered reference contact sheet, followed by per-frame measurement. Hands merged is one shared visible color region, not two inferred wrists. Component centers are not anatomical joints; no3D angles measured.
limitations: 406..410 only one dark foot region is clearly visible; the other lower-right dark triangle is tail, not the second foot.
390..401 and405..410 overlapping hands cannot be reliably separated from a single dark component.
After415 near-foot shadow joins belly shadow, so an explicit toe/foot ROI isolates only its visible left portion. Do not equate this to the full foot center.
Source frames often repeat poses for2..3frames; motion blur at390/400/409..411 increases uncertainty.

display_mapping.formula: x_target = uniform_scale*x_source + tx; y_target = uniform_scale*y_source + ty
display_mapping.use: Fixed image-plane comparison transform for every frame; never independently normalize each frame because that would erase the jump and fall.
display_mapping.warning: This is a 2D crop/zoom mapping, not an inferred 3D camera calibration.

measurement_provenance.coordinate_type: Measured visible 2D color regions, not inferred anatomical joints or3D ground truth
measurement_provenance.source_color_conversion: OpenCV VideoCapture BGR-to-RGB; fixed warpAffine mapping320x240 using INTER_AREA
measurement_provenance.connected_components: 8-neighbor connected components; components witharea>=4 native pixels sorted largest first; semantic IDs selected on an indexed reference contact sheet
measurement_provenance.foreground_threshold: Reject G>R+24 and G>B+24 and G>170
measurement_provenance.principal_axis: Eigenvector of image-plane foreground-pixel covariance; modulo180degrees, not a3D body rotation
measurement_provenance.roi_scope: manual_roi_xyxy appears directly in measurements where toe/foot shadow must be separated from belly shadow
measurement_provenance.archive_note: All frame/point values are unchanged from the reviewed iteration2 data; added source integrity and permanent mapping metadata only.
